Of course, one would expect a certain dignity in mourning, my dear Ash, yet you simply stand there.
Of course, the blood ruins the color of the grass, and now there is no one left to cook the meals.
Of course, my dear Ash, one does not need to dine like a starving beast to satisfy a mere appetite.
Of course, my dear Rook, one does not need to dismantle the furniture to express a lack of decorum.
Of course, my dear Ash, you might as well freeze solid; it would be a much more graceful exit than this.
Naturally, the morning fog is the least of our concerns when tribal spears are currently making an appearance.
Of course you would offer nothing but a silent nod, my dear Ash, as if my talent were merely a weather report.
Naturally, my dear Nate, dining upon the bare earth is an experience I had hoped to avoid.
Of course, my dear Ash, we must be grateful for the privilege of chewing on processed waste.
